notes: Encoded ONLY from Mammoth's own page (no usesStylesOf: the page's sister list alone does not establish shared-system reuse, and no Nordyne/Frigidaire rule is imported). COUNTING CONVENTION (Nordyne lesson, tested against this page's own examples): the page states positions as 'numerical digits', but digit-only counting is FALSIFIED by Style 2's own example FGA030310579 — its digits are 030310579, so 4th & 5th numerical digits = '31', which resolves to no year (1931 below the 1960 floor, 2031 future). Character counting decodes it (year '03' = 2003, month '03' = March) and decodes Style 3 (1999-05); digit-only counting would give Style 3 2005-05 but is not a live alternative once the page convention is fixed by the Style 2 falsification. Style 1 ships year-only (month = 3rd letter, chart-only). All three patterns are disjoint.
